alignment: Floor to last recorded frame at 30 fps. Simulator time excludes inference gaps.
content: Recorded assistant messages and tool calls; no private thinking blocks or editorial summaries.

steps.message: The basket is not in view. I'll look around by spinning the chassis.
Still no basket. Continuing to look around.
I can see a wicker basket on the lawn to the left (~140, 300). I'll spin to face it.
The basket is now centered ahead (~355, 290). I'll move to a reach point at the basket.
Skill active. The basket is close. Checking both grippers are empty via wrist cameras.
Need a fresh head image first.
Left arm is closer (0.81 vs 0.91 m). Preparing left arm with open gripper.
Left arm prepared. Planning grasp on the solid basket wall (lower front body).
Plan preview shows fingers enclosing the basket wall. Executing plan_0001 with left arm.
Wrist view is buried in the basket wall — grasp volume covers the basket. Closing left gripper.
Empty close — fingers closed with nothing between them. Restarting: open left arm, recapture, new point on the thick rim.
Planning grasp on the thick left-front rim.
Grasp volume is much better (36 cm³) and on the rim. Executing plan_0002.
Wrist shows grass — gap empty, gripper missed the rim. Checking head view before restart.
Left gripper ended up left of the rim. Restarting: retract arm open, then re-plan on a different rim point.
Arm retracted. Planning grasp on the front-right solid wall of the basket.
That click fell through the weave. Re-planning on the solid left rim.
Left rim is out of reach. Trying the dense near-bottom wall which is closest to the robot.
Points keep landing beyond reach gate or through the weave. Nudging chassis closer to the basket.
Closer now. Planning grasp on the thick front-bottom wall.
Red fingers enclose the front wall band. Executing plan_0003.
Wrist view is buried in the dense lower wall with fingers straddling it. Closing left gripper.
Fingers keep slipping through the open weave. The rolled rim is the only thick target — planning on the near rim directly facing the robot.
Fingers keep slipping through the open weave. The rolled rim is the only thick target — planning on the near rim directly facing the robot.
Preview overlapped grass. Re-clicking precisely on the near rim roll just below the eggs.
Hit is on the rim at z=0.32, fingers straddle it. Executing plan_0005.
Red grasp-volume pixels now lie on the basket wall between the fingers. Closing immediately.
Grasp confirmed — fingers pinching the basket wall. Basket is large, so stowing with reset_body keep_ori_arm=left.
Skill exited. Now carrying the basket to the tree ahead. Moving to a lawn point just in front of its root.
Next to the tree. Dropping the basket by opening the left gripper.
Basket dropped with eggs still inside. Recapturing to assess.
One egg is still inside the on-side basket. Activating pick-up-object to grasp the basket bottom and flip it.
Gripper is open (red is just nearby geometry under the low EEF). Preparing left arm.
Basket lying on its side with an egg inside; one egg already out. Planning grasp on the basket bottom (closed end, upper-left).
Fingers enclose the basket's closed-end wall (25 cm³). Executing plan_0006.
No red in the gap — the basket is beside the fingers, not between them. Restarting with a different point.
Basket is at the left frame edge. Backing up slightly and turning left toward it (keeping clear of the lawn egg).
Egg on the lawn is just ahead of the chassis — I won't drive over it. Planning grasp on the basket's closed-end body from here.
The lawn egg sits in the forward corridor. Backing away first, then turning left toward the basket.
Moving in on a lawn point just in front of the basket (line passes left of the lawn egg).
Basket bottom now faces the chassis (~0.45 m). Planning grasp on the dense bottom taper.
Basket bottom now faces the chassis (~0.45 m). Planning grasp on the dense bottom taper.
Bottom wall is between the fingers. Closing left gripper.
Fingers slipped through again at the taper. The rolled rim is the reliable feature — restarting for a rim grasp.
The basket shifted out of view and the lawn egg is close again. Backing up slightly to re-observe.
The basket shifted out of view and the lawn egg is close again. Backing up slightly to re-observe.
Basket visible ahead, opening facing right. Planning grasp on the right-side rim roll.
Shifting the chassis left to clear the lawn egg, then approaching the basket.
Shifting the chassis left to clear the lawn egg, then approaching the basket.
Egg is clear of the corridor now. Moving in toward the basket's near rim.
Basket is close with the near rim at lower center. Planning grasp on that rim roll.

The wrist view shows the basket weave filling the space directly between the two fingertips — the grasp volume covers solid basket material. Closing immediately.
Empty close again — the fingers slipped through the weave. Restarting the Skill loop: reopen the arm, fresh head capture, and plan on a visibly different solid rim point.
Basket is tilted upright with eggs visible inside. Planning a grasp on the thick near rim (the rolled mouth edge), the feature that worked before.
The far rim is beyond the shoulder gate. Trying the near bottom corner of the basket, which is much closer to the robot.
Basket stays just beyond the shoulder gate. I'll pitch the trunk a bit more forward to bring the shoulders closer, then re-plan.
Basket stays just beyond the shoulder gate. I'll pitch the trunk a bit more forward to bring the shoulders closer, then re-plan.
Ray passed through the weave to the lawn. The basket is front-right — trying the RIGHT arm, which is closer, on a solid near-rim point.
Right-arm plan_0009 valid with red fingers straddling the near rim band. Executing.
Basket wall fills the space between the fingertips — closing right gripper immediately.
Empty close again. Restarting the loop: reopen right arm, fresh capture, then target the thickest rim roll point with a different seed.
Empty close again. Restarting the loop: reopen right arm, fresh capture, then target the thickest rim roll point with a different seed.
Basket sits just out of reach and the egg guards the forward corridor. Short approach: move_to_reach_point at grass just left-below the basket corner (path clears the egg).
Now directly in front and close. Planning a left-arm grasp on the thick near base corner of the basket.
grasp_vol 20.9 cm³ — fingers straddle the thick corner band. Executing plan_0010 (left).
Wrist shows the basket base directly above between the fingertips. Closing left gripper.
Fingers again passed through the base weave. The rolled rim remains the only solid grasp surface — re-planning on the left rim roll.
Basket is out of the current head view (it's above/in front of the camera's look-down). Raising pitch to relocate it.
Basket ended up back-right and the lawn egg sits between chassis and basket. Backing up first to clear the egg before re-orienting.
Egg now guards the right-front footprint edge. Stepping the chassis left, away from it (lateral only, no rotation over it).
Egg clear of the footprint now. One more left step for rotation clearance, then spin right to find the basket.
Spinning right to bring the basket back into view.
Still not the basket — that's the lawn egg on the left. Continuing to spin right.
Still not the basket — that's the lawn egg on the left. Continuing to spin right.
Still not the basket — that's the lawn egg on the left. Continuing to spin right.
The 360° sweep was pitched too high to see a ground object. Pitching down, then facing back toward the basket's last bearing.
Basket should be ~0.8 m ahead-right from here. Small right spin to center it.
Basket should be ~0.8 m ahead-right from here. Small right spin to center it.

The look-down camera can't see beyond ~1.5 m. Tilting up to widen the horizon, then sweeping.
Visibility range is short, so I'll grid-search toward the basket's last known odometry sector (southwest). Turning to face it.
Found the tree trunk at front-right. Advancing toward it — the basket and eggs were last near its base.
Both found: lawn egg directly ahead and the basket at the tree base, top-right. Stepping left to clear the egg, then approaching the basket.
Both found: lawn egg directly ahead and the basket at the tree base, top-right. Stepping left to clear the egg, then approaching the basket.
Egg sits in the forward corridor; trunk ahead-right with the basket beyond it. Stepping left, rotating right, then advancing past the trunk side.

A grey object just peeking at the left edge — turning left to bring the basket into view.

Everything in frame: trunk ahead, the stray egg at 0.3 m, basket top-left. The egg is right in my reach and blocks the corridor — picking it up first (Skill still active). Planning a left-arm grasp on the egg body.
Solid egg grasp preview (27 cm³). Executing plan_0011 left.
Egg fills the grasp volume between the fingers. Closing left gripper.
Egg confirmed held (bilateral contact). Stowing: raising the arm to grasp-prep with the gripper kept closed.
Now placing: tracking the held egg's bottom on the current head image.
That point hit the lawn (z≈0). Re-grounding egg_bottom onto the egg's lowest visible underside.
egg_bottom z=0.498, gate needs <0.20. Lowering the left EEF 0.10 m per step (base-frame z only).
Lowered 0.1 m (z gate now 0.399). Continuing.
egg_bottom z = 0.309, still ≥ 0.20. One more lowering step.
Progress executed (0.088 m); egg_bottom z = 0.217, just above the 0.20 gate. One short final step of −0.05 m.
Gate passed: egg_bottom z = 0.176 < 0.20. Releasing on the lawn.
Gripper opened. Recapturing to confirm the egg sits on the lawn.
The egg is released but the gripper structure is still right under/around it (tracked bottom z≈0.10 — likely still resting on the open fingers). Lifting the left arm away, then recapturing.

Egg #1 is resting on the lawn next to the tree — confirmed visually (trunk just ahead, egg bottom-left, gripper clear above it). Now back to the basket (visible top-left). The egg sits only ~0.41 m front-left, too close for safe spinning, so first reverse straight back to clear it.
Egg now 0.72 m away — safe clearance for spinning. Rotating left to bring the basket into view.
Trunk is top-right; basket should be near it. Turning right to face the trunk area.
Trunk base is at the top edge; basket may be just beyond the visible band. Pitching up slightly to widen the view.
Basket is top-left (~1.2 m) and yellow specks visible inside — eggs still in. Turning left to face the basket.
The placed egg now sits in my forward corridor (0.44 m). Shifting left to clear it before approaching the basket.
Corridor clear, egg safely off to the right. Advancing toward the basket.
Basket ~1.0 m ahead with handle and inner eggs visible. Closing distance a bit more.
Skill active. Confirming both grippers empty via wrist cameras.
Both grippers empty. Preparing right arm for the grasp plan.
Basket open with eggs visible inside. Planning a grasp on the thick rim roll (right side, away from interior eggs).
Far rim point fails the shoulder gate. Advancing 0.2 m (egg stays clear at right), then re-planning on the near rim.
Planning grasp on the near rim roll (~0.5 m).
That point hit the far side (0.8 m). Clicking the near handle strap at ~0.48 m instead.
The basket sits off to the right, beyond the shoulder gate. Turning right to center it, then I'll close in.
Basket centered at 0.53 m. Planning grasp on its near rim roll.
Ray went through the weave to the far side. Clicking lower — the near bottom wall band (0.53 m), which is also the grasp the parent task wants for flipping.
Weave keeps leaking the depth ray to the floor. Closing another 0.15 m, then re-clicking right on the near base corner.
Now at 0.37 m. Planning on the solid base corner band.
Still leaking through the weave. Clicking exactly at the warning's solid near base-corner pixel.
All near-wall rays leak through the open mouth to the interior floor. The handle strap is the nearest solid target (~0.4 m) — planning there.
